messages:
kai: seeing repeated gRPC stream resets between model-pods in gpu-pool-eu-west, GPU util drops to ~20% even though requests are queued
Maggie: ouch, any packet drops in perf dashboard?
kai: yes, east-west errors spike on nodes 10-14, looks like fragmentation/reassembly timeouts in kernel
henry: could be MTU mismatch after last week's node replacement. new hosts had Mellanox NICs with default 1500 while old ones used 9000
maggie: that sounds plausible. are we using overlay (geneve) with encap overhead?
kai: yes, cni is calico with vxlan in that cluster. when combined with SR-IOV / IB fabric the effective PMTU falls.
henry: quick check commands: 
```
# on node with issues
ip link show eth0
ethtool -k eth0 | egrep "gso|gro|lro"
ip route get 10.42.3.14
sysctl net.ipv4.ipfrag_high_thresh
```

kai: ran tcpdump on pod interface, saw a lot of ICMP "fragmentation needed" from the ToR to the pod subnet
Maggie: any RDMA in the path? azure-like hostfabric or on-prem IB?
henry: Mellanox connected to IB spine for RDMA between GPU hosts, but user traffic is routed via ToR ethernet for east-west; mismatch there is suspicious
ops-oncall: deploy-bot flagged many model instances restarting due to stream timeouts, raising paged alerts at 02:12 UTC
kai: pasted snippet of tcpdump: 
```
12:34:56.789 IP 10.40.1.5 > 10.40.3.8: frag needed and DF set (mtu 1500)
12:34:56.790 IP 10.40.1.5 > 10.40.3.8: TCP 0 0 > 12345: Flags [R], seq 0, win 0
```

Maggie: so path MTU is 1500 but pod/host thinks jumbo is available -> fragments dropped on path or driver?
henry: slightly different: kernel tries GSO/GRO on 9000 mtu path but ToR clamps, causing offload to hand big skbs to ASIC which drops them
kai: I see repeated gso_checksum_split errors in dmesg on affected nodes
ops-oncall: immediate mitigation ideas?
maggie: can we force MTU to 1500 on the pod mesh quickly? that would avoid fragments but reduce throughput. or disable GSO for the interface as stopgap
henry: commands to run (low-risk):
```
# set pod-facing mtu to 1500 on host for calico veths
ip link set dev cali0 mtu 1500
# disable GSO/GRO on problematic NICs
etool -K eth0 gro off gso off tso off
```

kai: rolling that to nodes 10-14 now (one at a time). will monitor GPU util and gRPC errors
Maggie: also flagging networking to check ToR MTU and VXLAN encap MTU. if ToR is 1500 and we have geneve(50) + outer headers we need to clamp to less than 9000
henry: longer term: reconcile MTU policy across fabric, calico node config, and SR-IOV profiles. add a preflight to node autoscaler to check NIC default mtu before adding to gpu pool
ops-oncall: note cost impact: estimated 3 idle GPUs * $3/hr for 2 hours = $18 while we triage, logging for finance
kai: change complete on node-10: gRPC resets dropped immediately, GPU util up to 85% for that node
Maggie: awesome. start gradual roll for remaining nodes after post-deploy smoke test
henry: follow-ups: (1) run full PMTU probe across AZs, (2) audit recent node images that switched Mellanox driver behavior, (3) add MTU mismatch alert to infra dashboards
ops-oncall: assigning tasks in tracker: INFRA-1729 (postmortem + runbook), INFRA-1730 (preflight for autoscaler)
kai: thanks everyone. leaving notes in runbook and will add sample iperf and tcpdump snippets to the ticket
deploy-bot: deployment "mtu-clamp-roll" started for node-11 at 02:28 UTC :spinner:
